g.text: ADVANCED IOT SYSTEM POWER ARCHITECTURE & DUAL-RAIL ISOLATION
100–240V AC Mains | Optically Isolated Relay Power (JD-VCC) | AMS1117 3.3V Logic | Clean Low-Pass Filtered 15120P Rail
100V–240V AC 50/60Hz Input | T2A Fuse & 14D471K MOV Clamping
• T2A 250V Slow-Blow Fuse: Prevents fire hazards
by breaking instantaneously on short circuits or bridge fault.
utility spikes >275V AC (lightning, grid inductive bounce)
with response time <25ns, protecting SMPS electronics.
• Physical PCB Creepage Slot (>5mm): Air routing slot
milled directly through fiberglass beneath optocouplers
and power supply to prevent surface carbon tracking.
• Earth Ground Bond (PE): Fastened with star washer
directly to electrical metal enclosure for touch-safe operation.
✓ Live & Neutral completely isolated from DC planes
✓ Double insulated cabling for all 230V AC lines
Hi-Link HLK-5M05 | >3000V AC Galvanic Isolation Barrier
continuous output rating delivers ample energy reserve.
• 1000µF Low-ESR Reservoir Role: Prevents voltage sags
when all 4 relay coils pull in simultaneously (300mA step load),
guaranteeing <15mV transient drop on the 5V bus.
▲ RAIL 1: To Relay Module JD-VCC (High Inductive Load)
▼ RAIL 2: To ESP32 VIN (Sensitive Microcontroller & LDO)
🔒 Grounds segregated at SMPS star return!
Rail 1 (Coils) vs Rail 2 (MCU) Segregation | AMS1117 SOT-223 Low-Dropout Regulator
RAIL 2: ESP32-WROOM-32 MCU & AMS1117-3.3V LDO REGULATOR
• Strict Jumper Separation: Mechanical removal of JD-VCC jumper
guarantees 100% galvanic isolation between logic and coil domains.
• Isolated Coil Return: Inductive coil currents return directly
to SMPS via Relay GND, completely bypassing the ESP32 ground plane.
• Optical Barrier (EL817): Control signals cross via GaAs IR LEDs (>5000Vrms).
✓ Relay GND & MCU GND are 100% Galvanically Isolated
✓ Zero common-impedance coupling or ground bounce
✓ Eliminates unexpected ESP32 resets during AC contactor arc
✓ Star GND return prevents relay noise crossing into ADC
Series 100Ω + Dual Decoupling Filter (fc ≈ 338.6 Hz) | 15120P 38kHz IR Optical Rx
• D_ACT LED: Flashes on 38kHz burst (470Ω limiter)
• Noise Rejection: Shunts 2.4GHz Wi-Fi RF burst transients
and 100Hz SMPS ripple; rejects relay inductive spikes.
✓ 15120P runs at 100% sensitivity up to 15 meters
✓ Zero phantom clicks during Wi-Fi transmission bursts
✓ Dedicated rail isolated from inductive relay switching
📊 COMPLETE SYSTEM POWER BUDGET & LOAD ANALYSIS
Supply Rating: 2000 mA (10.0W) ──► 66.4% Reserve Margin (3.0x Safety Factor!)
The system maintains two strictly segregated ground return networks:
1. Relay Coil GND: Carries heavy inductive switching return currents.
2. ESP32 Logic GND: Clean reference for analog ADC and digital buses.
By removing the JD-VCC jumper, these two grounds remain 100% isolated.
De-energizing relay coils generate up to 200V reverse inductive voltage.
1N4148 flyback diodes across each coil suppress this energy locally,
preventing voltage spikes from polluting the 5V bus.
✓ Eliminates audio click buzz, EMI reboots, and brownout resets.
A physical clearance slot of >5.0mm is maintained between high-voltage
AC mains tracks (230V) and low-voltage DC traces (5V / 3.3V).
100Ω 2W resistor + 100nF 275V AC X2 metallized safety capacitor
across relay NO-COM contacts extinguishes high-voltage contact arcs.
Total quiescent heat dissipation is under 1.2W (<3.4W peak).
Enclosure temperature rise is <7.5°C above ambient in enclosed ABS box.
✓ Flame-retardant 94V-0 PCB substrate | Flame-proof MOV & Snubbers
